## Best
v1: val log_loss 0.31256 (mean of seeds 1, 2, 3), from run e20: CatBoost with 1000 iterations, learning_rate 0.01, depth 8, l2_leaf_reg 3, subsample 0.9, rsm 0.9
## Works
- [m1] (tested on v0; val -0.0822; runs e20,e25,e26,e27) CatBoost (1000 iters, lr 0.01, depth 8, l2 3, subsample/rsm 0.9) gets val log_loss ~0.3126, beating LR 0.3947 and RF/XGBoost. Re-checked: beats best.
- [m2] (tested on v0; val -0.0822; runs e8,e15,e19,e20) Boosted trees (GBM) outperform LR (0.394) and simple NN (0.319) on churn; LightGBM ~0.314-0.316, RF ~0.326. CatBoost edges them slightly.
## Failed
- [m3] (tested on v0; val -0.0521; runs e12,e23) class_weight/balanced (LR and RF) does not help churn log_loss; worsens when combined with deep trees + many estimators.
- [m4] (tested on v0; val -0.0001; runs e1,e5,e9) LogisticRegression with any C / no class_weight stays ~0.394-0.395, not competitive.
## Try next
- [m5] (tested on v0; runs e13,e24) In LightGBM early_stopping seemed unsupported in this env (researcher-1 e13/e24 errors); use hold-out set if needed. Unverified.
- [m6] (tested on v0; val -0.0822; runs e20) CatBoost Bayesian hyperparameter tuning + ensembling (average tree models) may gain further; not yet tried.

## Best
v1: val log_loss 0.31256 (mean of seeds 1, 2, 3), from run e20: CatBoost with 1000 iterations, learning_rate 0.01, depth 8, l2_leaf_reg 3, subsample 0.9, rsm 0.9
## Works
- [m1] (tested on v0; val -0.0822; runs e20,e25,e26,e27) CatBoost (1000 iters, lr 0.01, depth 8, l2 3, subsample/rsm 0.9) gets val log_loss ~0.3126, beating LR 0.3947 and RF/XGBoost. Re-checked: beats best.
- [m2] (tested on v0; val -0.0822; runs e8,e15,e19,e20) Boosted trees (GBM) outperform LR (0.394) and simple NN (0.319) on churn; LightGBM ~0.314-0.316, RF ~0.326. CatBoost edges them slightly.
- [m7] (tested on v1; val -0.0006; runs e40,e48,e52,e53,e54) Averaging 3 CatBoost + 1 LGBM + 1 XGB (diff seeds) -> val 0.31197 (runs e52-54); below noise vs 0.31256 (tie). Stacking w/ holdout worse (e37, 0.3259).
- [m8] (tested on v1; val -0.0005; runs e34,e36,e39,e44) Feature set A (log/ratio/product, drop surname, TF-IDF mean, country-gender interact) -> 0.31210 (e34). More features (e36) or 2000 iters (e39/e44) don't help.
## Failed
- [m3] (tested on v0; val -0.0521; runs e12,e23) class_weight/balanced (LR and RF) does not help churn log_loss; worsens when combined with deep trees + many estimators.
- [m4] (tested on v0; val -0.0001; runs e1,e5,e9) LogisticRegression with any C / no class_weight stays ~0.394-0.395, not competitive.
- [m5] (tested on v1; val +0.0007; runs e31,e38,e42) Early stopping: LGBM/XGB API unsupported (e13/e24/e38/e42); CatBoost internal-holdout early stop hurt (e31, 0.3133). Not useful here.
- [m9] (tested on v1; val +0.0020; runs e32,e50) depth=10 overfits (0.3146/e32); MLP w/ early stop 0.381 (e50). Not competitive vs CatBoost baseline.
## Try next
- [m6] (tested on v1) CatBoost Bayesian hp tuning still untried. Weighted avg or per-model diverse hparams may add ensemble diversity beyond plain averaging.

All changes are recorded. Here's my summary of this generation.

## Summary

**Re-check of the top researcher's ensembling code:** mean val 0.31197 (spread ~0.0001) vs best 0.31256 — a gain of only ~0.0006, well below the noise threshold (0.00197). This is a **tie, not a beat**, so the orchestrator should NOT promote it and the best remains v1.

**Key learning this generation: all four researchers' "gains" (+0.08% to +0.24%) were within noise — effectively all ties.** No genuine new best emerged.

**Memory updates:**
- **New `works` (m7):** averaging 3 CatBoost + 1 LGBM + 1 XGB (diverse seeds) gives val ~0.3120, a sub-noise marginal effect; stacking with a holdout set is worse (0.3259, e37).
- **New `works` (m8):** feature set A (log/ratio/product transforms, drop surname, TF-IDF mean, country-gender interactions) → 0.31210; adding more features or using 2000 iterations doesn't help.
- **`m5` moved `try_next`→`failed`:** early stopping is effectively unusable in this env (LGBM/XGB API mismatch) and CatBoost internal-holdout early stopping hurt (e31).
- **`m6` kept as `try_next`:** Bayesian tuning / weighted averaging / per-model diverse hyperparameters still untried (may add ensemble diversity).
- **New `failed` (m9):** depth=10 overfits (0.3146) and an MLP with early stopping is non-competitive (0.381).

No stale entries required re-testing, and no conflicts warranted the final reserved run (all findings were consistent ties), so it was left unused.
